rotation_target: Raw rotation matrix control versus cube-symmetry canonical representative nearest identity, deterministic tie break. Canonical choice is made on labels only; no test fitting.
angular_velocity: Convert native body-frame free-joint angular velocity to world frame with the stored object rotation. Verified against quaternion finite differences on saved physics traces.
features: Frame192 or concatenated history576. Current input[t-10,t-5,t]; future input[t-5,t,t+5]. Real or predicted endpoint occupies the identical last slot.
effect_alignment: For symmetry-trained probes, align each decoded candidate orientation to decoded nominal by the nearest cube symmetry, using decoded poses only. Compare resulting relative effect with full physical relative rotation; do not alter E_obj. This local ambiguity resolution does not recover unobservable large symmetry rotations.
scope: Diagnostic supervised readouts only, frozen LeWM and correction selection unchanged. Development nominal capture selects ridge alpha. Calibration remains separate for capture/effect reporting. No finaltest accessed.
numeric_precision: Probe fitting/inference float64 to avoid ill-conditioned float32 ridge solve. Native LeWM encoding and prediction stay float32.
direction_agreement: A predicted effect norm<=1e-8m has no direction. Conditional cosine requires both resolved true effect and nonzero prediction; report availability separately, including undefined zero-control direction.
